ei.title: The Internet and the Flattening of Truth
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: In many ways, the Internet has accelerated people's notion that the truth is relative. As Anna Kata argues, the Internet has facilitated a postmodern paradigm of truth in which expert consensus is delegitimized and personal values and experiences are treated the same as scientific evidence. Within this new paradigm, Kata notes, everyone is considered an expert and truth is "flattened," as each perspective and view of the facts is represented as legitimate, with evidence from legitimate experts considered one of multiple opinions. The changing nature of what is considered true is problematic in terms of misperceptions, as people are increasingly exposed to online discussions and debates about what is true. If extremely inaccurate evidence, personal experiences, or the words of charlatans are presented and considered alongside evidence from scientific consensus without consideration of validity based on evidence, it becomes more difficult for people to determine which information is legitimate and true. Furthermore, online postmodern discourses often shift the standards of evidence to suit participants' arguments, making it more likely that people will become confused about the facts and ultimately misinformed.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① accelerated: 인터넷이 진실의 상대성 개념을 '가속화했다' → 적절
② hindered: 인터넷이 포스트모던 패러다임을 '방해했다' → 촉진했다(facilitated)는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답
③ delegitimized: 전문가 합의의 정당성을 '약화시켰다' → 적절
④ legitimate: 각 관점이 '정당한' 것으로 표현됨 → 적절

If extremely ③<u>inaccurate</u> evidence, personal experiences, or the words of charlatans are presented and considered ④<u>apart from</u> evidence from scientific consensus without consideration of validity based on evidence, it becomes more difficult for people to determine which information is legitimate and true. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①problematic(문제가 있는) ②exposed(노출된) ③inaccurate(부정확한) ④apart from(떨어져←alongside)
det.analysis:
① problematic: 진실의 변화하는 성질이 '문제가 있다' → 적절
② exposed: 사람들이 온라인 토론에 '노출된다' → 적절
③ inaccurate: '극히 부정확한' 증거가 제시된다 → 적절
④ apart from: 과학적 합의와 '떨어져' 고려된다 → 나란히(alongside)라는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①shift(바꾸다) ②suit(부합시키다) ③enlightened(깨우친←confused) ④misinformed(잘못된 정보를 갖게 된)
det.analysis:
① shift: 증거 기준을 '바꾼다' → 적절
② suit: 참여자의 주장에 '부합시키기 위해' → 적절
③ enlightened: 사람들이 사실에 대해 '깨우쳐진다' → 혼란스러워진다(confused)는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답
④ misinformed: 사람들이 '잘못된 정보를 갖게 된다' → 적절

questions.passage:
(A) In many ways, the Internet has accelerated people's notion that the truth is <u>relative</u>. The idea that no single perspective holds absolute authority has become widespread in online discussions.

(B) The success of a policy is <u>relative</u> to the circumstances in which it is applied. What works in one country may not work in another.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 relative와 가장 가까운 의미로 쓰인 것은?

det.korean: relative: (A)(B) 상대적인 / ①상대적인(~에 비례한) ②친척 ③친척 ④relatively(부사 형태)
det.analysis:
본문의 relative는 '상대적인(not absolute)'의 의미.
① relative to the severity=심각도에 비례한/상대적인 → (A)(B)와 동일한 '상대적' 의미 ←정답
② distant relative=먼 친척 → 명사 용법
③ living relative=살아있는 친척 → 명사 용법
④ relatively speaking=상대적으로 말하면 → 부사 용법
det.tip: relative: (형용사) 상대적인 / (명사) 친척 — 두 의미 구분 필수

ch: The speed of recovery is relative to the severity of the injury.

det.analysis: be동사(is) 뒤에 과거분사형이 와서 수동태를 만들어야 하므로 delegitimize → delegitimized
det.tip: be + V-ed = 수동태 (is delegitimized = 정당성이 약화된다)

questions.passage: Online postmodern discourses often shift the standards of evidence to suit participants' arguments, __________ (make) it more likely that people will become confused about the facts and ultimately misinformed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문. 주절 뒤에 이어지는 결과 표현이므로 make → making (현재분사)
det.tip: 분사구문: 결과/동시동작을 나타낼 때 V-ing 사용

questions.passage: In many ways, the Internet has accelerated people's notion that the truth is relative. As Anna Kata argues, the Internet has facilitated a postmodern paradigm of truth in which expert consensus is delegitimized and personal values and experiences are treated the same as scientific evidence. Within this new paradigm, Kata notes, everyone is considered an expert and truth is "flattened," as each perspective and view of the facts is represented as legitimate, with evidence from legitimate experts considered one of multiple opinions. The changing nature of what is considered true is problematic in terms of misperceptions, as people are increasingly exposed to online discussions and debates about what is true. If extremely inaccurate evidence, personal experiences, or the words of charlatans are presented and considered alongside evidence from scientific consensus without consideration of validity __________, it becomes more difficult for people to determine which information is legitimate and true. Furthermore, online postmodern discourses often shift the standards of evidence to suit participants' arguments, making it more likely that people will become confused about the facts and ultimately misinformed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 증거에 기반한 타당성 고려 없이 제시된다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① shift the standards: 기준을 바꾸다 → validity 수식어로 부적합
② determine the facts: 사실을 판단하다 → 문맥 부적합
③ based on evidence: 증거에 기반한 → validity를 수식하는 표현으로 원문 일치 ←정답
④ online discussions: 온라인 토론 → 문맥 부적합

det.korean: 어떤 정보가 정당한지 판단하기 어렵다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① become confused about the facts: 사실에 혼란 → 원문의 다른 결과로 이미 언급됨

③ shift the standards of evidence: 기준을 바꾸다 → 원인으로 언급된 표현
④ treat personal values as scientific evidence: 개인 가치를 과학적 증거로 다루다 → 원문의 배경으로 이미 언급됨

ch: treat personal values as scientific evidence
